scope: Category-scoped email unsubscribe token, public confirmation/opt-out HTTP flow, and queue footer integration.
implemented: Opaque 32-byte URL-safe proofs are stored as hashes, expire after 30 days, bind to the current verified-email generation and queued recipient address, and consume idempotently for only the selected optional category. GET inspects and renders a confirmation without changing preferences; POST consumes the proof. Delivery adds a per-message escaped footer only after issuing a valid token. Invalid configuration, ineligible recipients, or token issuance failures fail closed before send; proof values are not persisted in jobs or emitted in logs.
